dedupe_keys.name: jodi oil world database monthly oil production trade refining stocks and demand for 90 countries

description: The JODI-Oil World Database gives monthly oil statistics reported by national administrations through a harmonised questionnaire. It grew from the Joint Oil Data Exercise launched in April 2001 by six international organisations (APEC, Eurostat, IEA, OLADE, OPEC and UNSD) after energy ministers asked for more transparent oil data. It covers thirteen product categories, from crude oil, NGL and other feedstocks to LPG, naphtha, gasoline, kerosene and jet fuel, gas and diesel oil, fuel oil and totals, and fourteen flows including production, trade, refinery intake and output, closing stocks, stock change and demand, in barrels, tonnes and litres. Data cover more than 90 participating countries from January 2002 to one month before release; the first update read was 22 September 2026, with 52 countries reporting July 2026 data. Full and annual files are free to download in CSV and Beyond 20/20 formats, with country notes, a manual and colour codes for data quality; the website terms of use apply and no data licence is stated. Caveats: completeness and timeliness vary by country, as the quality colour codes show. Simulation uses are oil supply disruption, stock cover and refinery throughput inputs for fuel supply resilience models. Related records: data-jodi-gas-world-database is the gas counterpart.
